entries.note: Alcampo is Auchan in Spain. Alcampo Supermercado Online; the pair is confirmed by AASA and asset links on www.compraonline.alcampo.es. entries.name: ALDI
entries.note: ALDI Spain belongs to ALDI Nord (seller ALDI Einkauf), not ALDI SÜD. Second app: Con ALDI (ALDI Central de Compras). No scheme for ALDI (job 335): aldinord is declared by all four ALDI Nord country apps, so iOS could open another country's app; the universal link opens this one. Scheme staffbase-conaldi for Con ALDI (job 335, Android manifest: apkpure v2026.4.143461448, certificate subject mitarbeiterapp.de, activity MainActivity; the iOS app's Info.plist is not public): Ambiguous Staffbase employee app: staffbase, eyoemployeeapp, staffbase-conaldi, conaldi-staffbase all on MainActivity; the brand-specific staffbase-conaldi picked (generic staffbase would hit any Staffbase app).
